name: Shoe Zone plc
summary: Shoe Zone plc, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a footwear retailer in the United Kingdom. The company offers boots, slippers, wellies, trainers, shoes, safety footwear, canvas, and sandals for men, women, boys, and girls. It also provides handbags, schoolbags, socks, shoe care products, and bracelets. The company sells products through its stores and website, shoezone.com. Shoe Zone plc was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Leicester, the United Kingdom.
